description.value: Glenwood Inn & Suites is a 38-room motel in Trail, BC, sitting close to the Columbia River, local parks, and downtown Trail in the heart of the Kootenays. The property offers indoor and outdoor pools, a whirlpool spa, a fitness centre, and BBQ common areas, making it a well-equipped base after a long day on the road. It is fully disability-accessible and offers free on-site parking.
